keyPoints: Prayikta kisi ghatna ke hone ki sambhavna ka naap hai — 0 (asambhav) se 1 (nishchit) ke beech.
Prayogik prayikta = (ghatna kitni baar hui) ÷ (kul prayog) — sikka 100 baar uchhalne par 53 chit to prayikta 0.53 — prayog badhne par ye 0.5 ke paas aayegi.
Jitne zyada prayog, prayogik prayikta utni hi siddhantik maan (jaise 1/2) ke paas — ye badi sankhyaon ka niyam hai.
Purak ghatna: P(nahi hoga) = 1 - P(hoga) — paase par 6 na aane ki prayikta 1 - 1/6 = 5/6.
Tash ke patton, gend ki thaili, paase-lattu ke sawalon me pehle kul sambhav parinam gino — jaise thaili me kul gendon ki ginti.
Samaan roop se sambhav parinamon me hi saral sutra lagta hai — pakshpati sikke par nahi, wahan prayogik prayikta hi sahara hai.
Aam galti: prayogik aur siddhantik prayikta ko ek samajhna — 10 uchhal me 7 chit aana 0.5 ke viruddh nahi hai.

title: Prayikta: Prayogik
